findings.title: Security bulletin conflicts on whether release 7.2.9 is fixed

evidence.observation: On the dated security bulletin, the release table lists branch 7.2 affected versions 7.2.0 through 7.2.8 and fixed release 7.2.9, but the following paragraph states that version 7.2.9 remains affected and that no fix is available on branch 7.2. This leaves the decision-critical status of 7.2.9 unresolved for readers and extractors.

suggested_action.summary: Reconcile the 7.2.9 table row and explanatory paragraph, then publish one unambiguous affected and fixed status.
suggested_action.mechanism: Use a single authoritative status for 7.2.9 and state the supported upgrade path directly in the bulletin and installation instructions.
suggested_action.verification: Fetch the bulletin and confirm the table and prose agree on 7.2.9, with an explicit fixed release or explicit statement that no fix exists.

readiness.detail: robots.txt permits wildcard access and all sampled AI/search roles; three requested first party pages returned 200.
Readable source text, headings, links and the security table were captured from three HTML pages.
Core offer, licence and installation questions are answerable; the 7.2.9 security-status question is partial because the bulletin contradicts itself.
Independent external corroboration was unavailable within this source-only run.
Two source journeys reached the bulletin and installation endpoint through labeled same-site links; rendered interaction and continuity were not checked.
